name: Villaverde del Monte (Spain)
description: Square green flag charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Villaverde del Monte (a mountain, a tree and a castle on white and green).
history: Municipal flag of Villaverde del Monte; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Villaverde del Monte arms — mountain, tree and castle
